claims.text: A standard 88-key piano has 36 black keys.
A standard 88-key piano does not have 30, 32 or 40 black keys.
Each octave of a piano keyboard has five black keys, in a group of two and a group of three.
An 88-key piano runs from A to C: seven full octaves give 35 black keys, and one more lies between the two lowest white keys.
